reviews.title: Perfect work and gaming monitor!
reviews.comment: The Z1RCARZOPA 16" 2.5K Portable Monitor has been a great addition to my setup. The 2.5K resolution is sharp and clear, making text, videos, and multitasking look much better than standard portable monitors. It’s lightweight, slim, and very easy to travel with. Setup was quick with USB-C, and it worked seamlessly with my laptop. The display quality, colors, and build feel surprisingly premium for the price. Overall, it’s an excellent portable monitor for work, gaming, or entertainment.
reviews.author: Rudy

reviews.title: Great Buy
reviews.comment: This is a sleek looking, lightweight, portable monitor. I have used the monitor all day, everyday, for the last 3 weeks or so. I am really happy with the monitor connected to my laptop via a Thunderbolt 4/5 dock. Audio output is decent but not for audiophile. On the other hand, I am definately impressed by its brightness, color, and crisp image quality, though I haven't used for gaming. I really love it!
reviews.author: A.I.

reviews.title: The Ideal Sweet Spot of Portable Monitors!
reviews.comment: After a ton if research and some Hand wringing over the many portable monitors to choose from, I got this one and haven’t looked back. It’s a great size, not too small but not too big which makes it easy to lug around - especially since it’s so light. Functionally, it’s super easy to set-up and the monitor is bright enough for a room with lots of windows which helps a ton. Picture quality is great. I worried about the built-in stand but it works fine, is elegant and seems to be sturdy. No issues. This is a great all around, do-it-all monitor that will get most people most of what they need without breaking the bank. Would definitely buy this over lower cost monitors, but I’d also think twice about spending more than you need to. Unless you have speciality needs like intense gaming or graphic design, this is probably going to hit the sweet spot of the most functionality, the highest quality and the best price (and specially for a bright screen), in this price bracket. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Russell Sands

reviews.title: I would buy another in an instant!!!
reviews.comment: I have been looking for a portable monitor with a gloss finish. After reviewing A LOT of monitors, and following Arzopa on TikTok as it was and is very popular, I chose this one. I am so very happy with this monitor. I know it is a matte finish screen, however after several recommendations on how this would be the best option for someone studying graphic design I purchased it. I work with Macbook's and the connection is seamless. I position the Arzopa in different postitions as an external monitor depending on how I am set up. It is either the bottom monitor so the mouse goes from top to bottom, or on a side. The color is amazing and the clarity and sharpness are true to the description. It is easy to adjust the color, brightness, etc. I am able to get work done with ease and quickly. The size makes it easy for me to take on the go as I am at different locations to study. Granted it is powered off the laptop, I am never worried about it shutting down. I highly recommend this particular model for anyone working in or studying graphic design, and/or in the business of creating. The size of the screen is great and being able to set the display size to various settings, such as 1280x800 to 2560x1600. This allows me to see what project I am working on in order to see up close or multiple images at once. Arzopa customer service is great as well. They reach out after you register your device with an email letting you know where to contact them in case anything is wrong. I really liked this as I look through emails for information more than a manual sent with the product.
reviews.author: Mandy G

reviews.title: Great monitor - large, clear, affordable, cables included!
reviews.comment: Very pleased with this monitor so far - easy to connect via USB-C or HDMI. I had to use an external USB power-adapter in a couple cases, or else the screen flickered. And I'm trying to be extra careful with the seemingly-fragile support-leg, but so far so good! The size is a nice complement to my MacBook air, and should make for an excellent portable/emergency monitor. I appreciate the cables that were included in the box.
reviews.author: Ari F
